name: Coveralls GitHub Action
description: Send test coverage data to Coveralls.io for analysis, change tracking, and notifications.

format.description: Force coverage format, supported formats: lcov, simplecov, cobertura, jacoco, gcov, golang, python

flag-name.description: Job flag name, e.g. "Unit", "Functional", or "Integration". Will be shown in the Coveralls UI.

build-number.description: Override the build number autodetected from CI. This is useful if your CI tool assigns a different build number per each parallel build.

parallel.description: Set to true if you are running parallel jobs, then use "parallel-finished: true" for the last action.

parallel-finished.description: Set to true for the last action when using "parallel: true".

carryforward.description: Comma separated flags used to carryforward results from previous builds if some of the parallel jobs are missing.

allow-empty.description: Don't fail when coverage report file is empty or contains no data

base-path.description: The root folder of the project that originally ran the tests

compare-ref.description: Branch name to use as the base for coverage results

compare-sha.description: Commit SHA to use as the base for coverage results

measure.description: Show execution time of parsing and reporting

fail-on-error.description: Whether to fail (exit code 1) on any issues while uploading the coverage

coverage-reporter-version.description: Version of coverage-reporter to use. Make sure to prefix the version number with 'v'. For example: v0.6.9

coverage-reporter-platform.description: Platform of coverage-reporter to use on Linux runners. Supported values: auto-detect (default), x86_64, aarch64, arm64.
